entries.title: Ezekiel 23:1
segments: ¶And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:2
segments: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:3
segments: And they committed whoredom in Egypt; they committed whoredom in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there were handled the teats of their virginity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:4
segments: And their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister; and they were mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:5
segments: And Oholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she lusted after her lovers, after the Assyrians [her] neighbours,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:6
segments: clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them attractive young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:7
segments: And she bestowed her whoredoms upon them, all of them the choice of the children of Asshur; and with all after whom she lusted, with all their idols she defiled herself.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:8
segments: Neither left she her whoredoms [brought] from Egypt; for in her youth they had lain with her, and had handled the breasts of her virginity, and poured their fornication upon her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:9
segments: Therefore I gave her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the children of Asshur, after whom she lusted.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:10
segments: These discovered her nakedness, they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword; and she became a name among women; and they executed judgment upon her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:11
segments: ¶And her sister Oholibah saw [this], and was more corrupt in her passion than she, and in her fornications more than the whoredoms of her sister.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:12
segments: She lusted after the children of Asshur [her] neighbours, governors and rulers, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them attractive young men.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:13
segments: And I saw that she was defiled: both took one way.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:14
segments: And she increased her fornications; for she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:15
segments: girded with girdles upon their loins, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them captains in appearance, [after] the likeness of the children of Babylon, of Chaldea, the land of their nativity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:16
segments: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she lusted after them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:17
segments: And the children of Babylon came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their fornication; she too defiled herself with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:18
segments: And she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness; and my soul was alienated from her, like as my soul was alienated from her sister.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:19
segments: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she played the harlot in the land of Egypt;

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:20
segments: and she lusted after their paramours, whose flesh is [as] the flesh of asses, and whose issue is [as] the issue of horses.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:21
segments: And thou didst look back to the lewdness of thy youth, in the handling of thy teats by the Egyptians, for the breasts of thy youth.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:22
segments: ¶Therefore, Oholibah, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy soul is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:23
segments: The children of Babylon, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, all the children of Asshur with them; all of them attractive young men, governors and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:24
segments: And they shall come against thee [with] armour, chariots and wheels, and with an assemblage of peoples; they shall set themselves against thee [with] target, and shield, and helmet round about; and I will put judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:25
segments: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall cut off thy nose and thine ears, and thy remnant shall fall by the sword; they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:26
segments: They shall also strip the of thy garments, and take away thy fair jewels.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:27
segments: And I will make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom [brought] from the land of Egypt; and thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:28
segments: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give thee over into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy soul is alienated.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:29
segments: And they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare; so that the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy fornications.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:30
segments: These things shall be done unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the nations, because thou hast defiled thyself with their idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:31
segments: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; and I have given her cup into thy hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:32
segments: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large; thou shalt be for a laughing-stock and a derision, [for] it containeth much.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:33
segments: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, the cup of thy sister Samaria;

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:34
segments: thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt gnaw the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken [it], saith the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:35
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy fornications.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:36
segments: ¶And Jehovah said unto me, Son of man, wilt thou judge Oholah and Oholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:37
segments: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also passed over unto them their children, whom they bore unto me, to be devoured.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:38
segments: Moreover this have they done unto me: in the same day have they defiled my sanctuary and profaned my sabbaths.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:39
segments: For when they had slaughtered their children unto their idols, they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, thus have they done in the midst of my house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:40
segments: And furthermore, they sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and behold, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thine eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments;

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:41
segments: and satest upon a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hadst set mine incense and mine oil.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:42
segments: And the voice of a multitude living carelessly was with her; and with people of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, and they put bracelets upon their hands, and a beautiful crown upon their heads.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:43
segments: And I said of her that was old in adulteries, Will she now commit her fornications, even she.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:44
segments: And they went in unto her, as they go in unto a whorish woman: so went they in unto Oholah and unto Oholibah the lewd women.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:45
segments: And righteous men, they shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses, and with the judgment of women that shed blood; for they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:46
segments: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up an assemblage against them, and will give them to be driven hither and thither and spoiled.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:47
segments: And the assemblage shall stone them with stones, and despatch them with their swords; they shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:48
segments: And I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, and all women shall receive instruction and shall not do according to your lewdness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:49
segments: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols; and ye shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.
